name: heroes-8
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. ONE production atlas of TWENTY full-body human hero sprites for Reading Adventure.
Reference1 is the approved smooth grayscale hero atlas: match these SAME male/female faces, friendly eyes, softly rounded proportions, black confident outer contours and gray cel shading. Reference2 is PET's companion art style. Preserve clean organic illustrated volume. No pixel art, stepped outlines, dithering, texture, photorealism or 3D.
Exactly FIVE columns and FOUR rows on genuine TRANSPARENT background, white interiors remain opaque. Row1: MALE outfits1–5. Row2: FEMALE outfits1–5. Row3: MALE outfits6–10. Row4: FEMALE outfits6–10. Twenty fully separated silhouettes with generous transparent gutters. Same relaxed standing pose and complete height/baseline in each row. Each sprite about2.8heads tall. Male short dark swept hair, female medium dark hair with side fringe, identical faces/proportions across all costumes. Every costume is complete and equally covered for both sexes. Costume shapes must fit a moderately narrow portrait silhouette, no large detached wings or effects. Larger ceremonial clothes remain readable as broad clean shapes, no tiny filigree.
Smooth BLACK outside contour about1.3% of figure height, clear black hair accents, 3 clean gray shades plus white. Every ear, hand, shoe, hem, hat and cape complete with safe margins. Each sprite centered in an equal cell. No text, labels, UI, grid lines, floor, scenery, companions, aura or cast shadow. All weapons remain sheathed or omitted; no extra hand-held prop unless outfit calls for one.
OUTFIT DESIGNS (both male/female for each):
1. Dawn seraph: white ceremonial armor and two small integrated feather wings
2. Celestial knight: majestic symmetric pale armor, wing-shaped shoulders and compact halo crown
3. Lunar seraph: crescent armor, long white robe and two integrated moon-feather wings
4. Solar seraph: sunburst breastplate, feather mantle and integrated radiating crown
5. Astral archon: large star-shaped collar and ceremonial segmented armor
6. Heavenly regent: majestic royal robe, feather shoulders and high symmetrical crown
7. Star paladin: white faceted plate armor, broad star cloak and bright geometric crown
8. Sky sovereign: towering layered mantle, wing-shaped robe panels and open-face crown
9. Eclipse guardian: half-dark half-white ceremonial plate armor and circular eclipse collar
10. Cosmic librarian: grand layered book-like robes and enormous star-shaped shoulder mantle
